mission.display_title: Form the conditional expectation of one RV given another
mission.mission_purpose: Today's Mission exists to obtain the conditional expectation of one random variable given the value of another — so E[Y|X=x] (or equivalent) is a usable object — without pretending the tower / total-expectation mean-variance LO is finished.
mission.tutor_intent: Today I will force the candidate to form or interpret E[Y|X=x] from a joint or conditional setup — and refuse treating 'I can compute an ordinary expectation' as having conditional expectation.
mission.educational_intent: Produce a cognitive move from joint/conditional structure to lawful conditional expectation of one RV given another.
mission.learning_objective: Obtain and interpret the conditional expectation of one random variable given the value of another random variable.
mission.concept_focus: Joint/conditional → E[Y|X=x] as a function of x → refuse ordinary-E-as-conditional.
mission.prior_bridge: Campaign Epsilon closed joint distributions through linear combinations (2.2) with Revision. Today opens topic 2.3 at LO 2.3.1 — the named Continuity Front after CS1-005.
mission.why_now: After joints, form E[Y|X] carefully — mean and variance via conditioning build on this next.
mission.expected_benefit: Study Progress for conditional expectation — not Topic Complete for 2.3.2.
mission.explainability: Assigned as Campaign Zeta Day 1 because CE-001 / EP-001 Continuity Front names 2.3 as the handoff from Epsilon.

knowledge_checks.title: Active Recall: 2.3.1
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. (1) In words, what is E[Y|X=x]? (2) How does it differ from E[Y]? (3) Name one operation or setup that produces it from a joint/conditional.
hints: Use CMP language from today's notes.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: E[Y|X=x] is the expected value of Y when X is fixed at x — a function of x. It is not the same as the unconditional E[Y]. Obtain it from the conditional distribution of Y|X=x (or equivalent joint setup in the CMP).
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Skipping the LO hinge or swallowing the next LO.

knowledge_checks.title: Checkpoint: 2.3.1
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. A colleague says 'we already know how to take expectations, so conditional expectation is just the same skill.' Refuse in one sentence and restate what today's LO adds.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Refuse: ordinary expectation is not conditional expectation. Today's skill is E[Y|X=x] (or equivalent) — expectation under the conditioned world, as a function of the conditioning value.
